Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1456
Claimant:
Nicole Mooney
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
4 Jan 2025
Loss reported by the insured driver, who states the vehicle was struck while turning left at an intersection. The other
driver has been identified and is named on the policy.
20 Jan 2025
Recorded the insured's account by phone. The insured describes a slow turn across the oncoming lane and a light
contact to the front quarter panel of the vehicle.
23 Jan 2025
Police report obtained. The responding officer confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene and notes the
collision was consistent with a left-turn impact.
9 Feb 2025
Scene photographs and two independent witness statements received. Both witnesses describe the collision as the
insured described it.
11 Mar 2025
Inspected the insured vehicle. The visible damage lines up with the reported impact point, and no prior damage to the
vehicle is known from our records or from the repair history.
26 Mar 2025
Bodily injury claim opened after the claimant's attorney contacted us. The claimant reports neck and back strain and
is now represented.
29 Apr 2025
Reviewed the medical records. The reported injury seems severe for an impact this light, though the claimant has
been consistent about symptoms and has not described the accident differently in any conversation.
15 May 2025
Checked prior claims and medical history. No earlier injury to the neck or back has been identified for this claimant.
4 Jun 2025
Treatment followed a typical course of care, with frequency tapering as the claimant's reported improvement
continued. No gaps or unusual procedures noted in the billing.
20 Jun 2025
Coverage cnofirmed as active at the time of loss. Nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage predates the policy
start.
20 Jul 2025
Discussed the file with the claimant's attorney, who restated the accident account and asked for an evaluation of the
injury claim. Response to be prepared after the treating physician's final report arrives.
22 Jul 2025
Current status: liability facts are supported by the police report, witnesses, photos and the other driver's account. The
injury evaluation remains open pending final medical review and attorney correspondence.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
